issue.description:
Comment create/reply/resolve/unresolve landed on main (67766fc8, 4b2492ab, 16fe8f95) as new mutating operations, and AGENTS.md requires every mutating operation to be atomic, auditable, and concurrency-tested; no concurrency/fencing coverage for comments is visible in the recent history and no open bead carries it. Deliver: concurrent-writer tests for a single comment thread (reply vs resolve, resolve vs unresolve), interleaving of comment mutations with claim/close of the parent bead, an explicit decision on whether comments on a claimed bead require the claim-epoch credential (the P0 fence) or are deliberately credential-free — recorded in help and schema either way — and checkpoint round-trip/restore coverage for comment records with unknown fields preserved.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
